# Hartevo

> Hartevo is a developer SaaS that helps indie developers and SaaS founders measure and improve how AI answer engines cite and describe their products.

Hartevo measures and improves whether AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) cite your app/SaaS, then helps you fix it and distribute content. For indie devs and SaaS founders.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://hartevo.com) — about Hartevo.
- [Hartevo FAQ](https://hartevo.com/faq) — FAQ.
- [Hartevo Alternatives](https://hartevo.com/alternatives) — Alternatives & how to choose.
- [Hartevo vs Manual Prompt Tracking](https://hartevo.com/compare-hartevo-vs-manual-prompt-tracking) — Comparison.
- [Hartevo vs Traditional SEO](https://hartevo.com/compare-hartevo-vs-traditional-seo) — Comparison.
- [Tracking Whether ChatGPT Cites Your SaaS](https://hartevo.com/use-cases/tracking-whether-chatgpt-cites-your-saas) — Use case.
- [Fixing How AI Engines Describe Your Product](https://hartevo.com/use-cases/fixing-how-ai-engines-describe-your-product) — Use case.

## Honest framing

Hartevo content here is value-first and truthful: no fabricated reviews, ratings, statistics or awards. Comparison and alternatives pages describe who each option is for, not "we are better".
